race.comment: MR FABULOUS (2) is the one to beat despite a plain tenth behind Andron at Rosehill over 2400m, where he was unwanted in the market and made little impression from the rear. Assess on his fourth in a BM78 two back, has won at this track and has already scored at around 2500m. Maps well and can play a leading role. SORRY SUNSHINE (4) brings the sharpest recent country form, with two wins this season and a close fifth in a BM66 at this venue after being slow to begin. The first try at 2500m is the obvious query, but weight relief and a strong jockey-horse record keep him right in the contest. THAT A BOY (6) has been beaten just under three lengths at both recent runs and handles good ground, although the BM74 and new distance both ask more. VALENTINE JOHN (3) has a win from his only try at this distance and beat MR FABULOUS home at Rosehill, but his past two runs have lacked the finishing strength required to be more than a place prospect.
